title: My projects
intro: A project is one thing you are teaching the computer to recognise. Each one keeps its own classes, photos and trained model.
xaiQuote: Don't trust AI blindly: learn to see how it works inside.
xaiWhy: Explainable AI (XAI) helps you understand why a model decides something. That way you can spot errors, bias, or hallucinations before trusting an answer and make transparent, responsible decisions.

cv.title: Lab CV
cv.subtitle: Computer vision
cv.body: Image classification, heat maps, occlusion and shortcuts.

llm.title: Lab LLM
llm.subtitle: Language models
llm.body: Next-word probabilities, prompt comparator, word lens, biases and hallucinations.

storageLocation: Stored locally in your browser's IndexedDB database on this device. It is not synced to an account or uploaded anywhere.
empty: You have no projects yet. Make one and start teaching.
namePlaceholder: For example: fruit or not fruit
nameTooLong: That name is too long — 60 characters at most.
deleteBody: This removes the project, its classes, all {{count}} photos and its trained model from this device. Nothing was uploaded anywhere, so this cannot be undone.
anonymousBody: Everything works, and nothing will be saved to an account. Your projects stay in this browser on this device — clearing your browser data removes them.
restoreBody: "{{name}}" was made on a different device. Your photos and trained model stay on the device that captured them, so they are not here. You can start a fresh copy with the same classes.
restoreRecorded: That device recorded {{classes}} classes and {{samples}} photos.

model.training: Training did not finish — start it again
model.failed: Training did not work — try again
